# System packages every CI job needs.
#
# The workspace links libwayland, EGL/GLES, libdrm, libudev, libinput, and
# libsystemd (logind session arbitration). ripgrep is an undeclared but hard
# dependency of the acceptance scripts, dbus provides the session bus the
# capability backends expect, and systemd provides systemd-analyze for unit
# validation.
libwayland-dev
libegl-dev
libgles-dev
libdrm-dev
libudev-dev
libinput-dev
libsystemd-dev
pkg-config
ripgrep
dbus
systemd
